newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO slams unilateral Israeli pullback decision.
newsitem.headline: PLO slams unilateral Israeli pullback decision.

text.p: A Palestinian spokesman on Friday slammed the extent of Israel's further troop withdrawal in the West Bank.

"I think we are facing a real crisis in the peace process now, and when I say a real crisis I mean it," Saeb Erekat, minister of local government in the Palestinian Authority and a peace negotiator said.

After a seven-hour overnight debate Israel's cabinet on Friday voted 10-7 to back a proposal by Prime Minister Netanyahu to hand over another nine percent of the West Bank to the Palestinians, said a government spokeswoman.
Two percent of the area to be handed over comprises territory that is fully under Israeli control.

Israel Radio quoted Erekat saying the Palestine Liberation Organisation's understood that three Israeli pullbacks called for in a deal signed in January were each to consist of 30 percent of lands still controlled by Israel.

"I will not say what we will do but we're urging the Israelis...that we should sit down, discuss the whole issue...We want to solve our problems by negotiations and now they're insisting on dictating to us and that's totally poisoning the atmosphere of the negotiations," Erekat said.
